episodes.title: Flyaway
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of a joyous wedding gone awry, the bride goes missing in South America and the military men in her family vow to find her.

episodes.title: Tora Bora in the City
episodes.summary: At the American embassy in Bogota, the men run into bureaucracy. They find an ally in a powerful banker and embark on an impromptu mission.

episodes.title: The Gambler
episodes.summary: Prince uses his media savvy to pressure the American and Colombian governments to own the mission, setting off a chain reaction in the jungle.

episodes.title: Upriver
episodes.summary: Bambi loses the guerilla's trail and reacquaints himself with whiskey. Prince recovers from his wounds and starts putting the mess behind him.

episodes.title: We Reject Your Influence
episodes.summary: Amber reaches her final destination at a Venezuelan black site. She's told she will die there.

episodes.title: Habeas Thumpus
episodes.summary: Bambi receives a surprise visit from an old pal at the CIA. Prince has a change of heart. A daring plan is formulated to set up a prisoner exchange.

episodes.title: Red Is Positive, Black Is Negative
episodes.summary: Prince and Bambi negotiate the hard way, crossing a line. Violetta probes the government's possible involvement.

episodes.title: Family Matters
episodes.summary: Amber loses her grip on reality and faces execution. Out of options, Prince and Bambi arm up and recruit mercenaries for a historic raid.

episodes.title: Scorched Earth
episodes.summary: As night falls, Prince, Bambi, and their team set out across the border, fulfilling Bambi's promise to knock the place over.

episodes.title: Heat
episodes.summary: Season finale. Violeta strikes back to save her country. The men must consider what happens if you rescue someone who doesn't want saving.
